QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_8

question.text: 'Yamuna Growth Category II AIF' invested INR 10 crore for 10% stake with a 2.0x PARTICIPATING (double-dip) liquidation preference. The start-up is acquired for INR 500 crore. Assuming no other preference shareholders, how much will the AIF receive?

explanation.text: The Logic: Participating = pref AMOUNT + pro-rata of residual. Step 1: AIF takes 2x pref = INR 20 crore off the top. Step 2: Residual = 500 - 20 = INR 480 crore distributed to all shareholders pro rata. AIF's 10% share of INR 480 crore = INR 48 crore. Total = 20 + 48 = INR 68 crore. The Trap: INR 50 cr is plain 10% equity (ignores pref). INR 20 cr is pref-only (ignores participation). INR 100 cr is an arbitrary double.
